reviews.text:
You should remove the Exotic Animals category from the services listed on Google if you no longer have veterinarians to do so.
In an emergency, I came here with a found, injured animal in need of rescue, and all I got was a resounding "no." That time you waste searching for specific information online can make all the difference. Correct the services for intellectual honesty and put someone with a little more empathy at the reception desk; it wouldn't hurt.

Two years later, I brought Mich the cat, a semi-stray in terrible condition, to the Pavese Veterinary Clinic. He was treated and vaccinated and has recovered very well: he now weighs 6.3 kg, down from 5 kg.

Thank you so much to everyone. Always professional and kind, with patients and clients ♡

Competent, helpful, kind, everyone. My cat Clorinda is one of their patients. She has been spayed, vaccinated, and is under medical supervision at the Pavese Veterinary Clinic. You can contact them by phone via WhatsApp and at their offices. You can request prescriptions online.
We are very happy to go there and I recommend it.
Silvia, Valentina, and Clorinda.
Kindness and professionalism

Terrible, I brought a kitten of just 2 years old who had been vomiting for 24 hours already to make an appointment it seemed like I was asking for a favor even though I had pointed out the situation of continuous episodes of vomiting, once I received the note after a superficial visit with a cost of € 52 without even wanting to do some tests they told me that the cat is fine there is no danger and that the vomiting episodes were caused by something that the cat had ingested but that he would not vomit again, this happened on Saturday, Sunday I left and left the kitten with a cat sitter asking her the courtesy that if the cat continued to vomit to take him again to the clinic, Tuesday after another 3 days of vomiting the cat sitter took him now completely dehydrated to the clinic who called me urgently saying that the cat is at the end of his life and needs urgent surgery at a cost of € 250 of tests which made up € 1645 and more euros of operation of which the emergencies cost more than the operation and clearly there was also a charge of 273 for each day of hospitalization... all supported by estimates and invoices which I attach for proof. Draw your own conclusions. I wasn't in Rome, but thanks to the cat sitter he was operated on and is safe at a cost of 800 compared to the 2000 euros or more they asked.
A competent, available, and attentive practitioner. He was able to examine our dog on a Sunday and gave us excellent advice, making a great effort to communicate in French. Thank you!

Apart from a few times when I had to queue by appointment, every time I went there with my cat they always proved to be patient, professional, they all put in the effort (male and female) and you can see that they love animals...👍👍👍 …

My first experience with the clinic was with my son Tobia, for whom, unfortunately, I didn't have much hope. The entire staff was not only very professional and helpful, but also very empathetic, demonstrating a humanity that is not to be taken for granted. I thank everyone for the loving care shown to Tobia and to me as well. I can only, in my own small way, highly recommend this clinic.
Thanks for our lovely Lupin Bibi and Donnie
Excellent clinic, excellent all the staff.
I've been trying to call since 10am, 3 calls have gone unanswered, too bad, I took my cat to another vet in Mostacciano

Today we took our 16-year-old Norwegian Forest cat Tommi to the Pavese Veterinary Clinic and were truly delighted.

The doctors were kind, fantastic, professional, and caring, making us immediately feel like we were in good hands. They treated Tommi with great care and expertise, as well as great compassion.

A truly top-notch veterinary clinic, which we wholeheartedly recommend.

My experience has been completely negative. My dog ​​has been treated at the facility for years for an enteropathy. I've been prescribed countless tests and examinations, which I've always undergone for my dog's well-being, but they've never managed to reduce or improve her symptoms. Every week, they told me to change or introduce new medications or supplements, only to experiment with unsuccessful results. Last but not least, I'd like to highlight the rudeness of the people who answer the phone, always annoyed. Absolutely avoid.

Extremely professional! Dr. Fabio Bartoli is extremely kind and meticulous when examining our patient. Their service is truly helpful; they're always available for any questions or concerns. I absolutely recommend them!
For about 20 years I have experienced the skill, professionalism, and love for our...almost children! Well done!
Highly qualified veterinary facility, friendly and kind medical staff and assistants, I have also recommended it to other people and they all had the same impressions as me

The clinic's professionalism, combined with a humanity that's rare in veterinary clinics these days, is a strong point. The familiarity with which they approach problems makes you forget the seriousness of our furry friends' problems. Well done everyone, and kudos to Bartoli.
They saved our bunny's life twice. Always kind and helpful. And, of course, knowledgeable. Even with so-called "exotic" animals.

I have two rabbits and a dog, and without them I could never feel at ease. My furry friends are in excellent hands with all the wonderful vets... Fabio, the best!!! They are all truly expert, knowledgeable doctors and offer great support for the many needs our non-human friends may have. Kindness and courtesy are the watchwords at this truly exceptional clinic.
The kindness and responsibility with which they care for their little patients is commendable. They truly care for the living beings who come to them!

Terrible experience. Today my husband brought our cat with a heart condition for a problem. The cat was hyperventilating and very agitated. They didn't even examine him... you deserve a complaint. A respectable clinic employs staff capable of dealing with emergency situations. You can't refuse assistance to a cat in those conditions. Luckily, we resolved the situation differently.
I had a great time at this facility, Dr. Alessandra was very sweet and excellent with my monk parakeet, thank you so much 🦜💚 …

I brought my cat Rajah for the first time last year, and for the first time, he didn't have to be sedated, thanks to the kindness and expertise of the doctors. He also received excellent care. Anna M. Nocentino

EXCELLENCE AND HEART AT THE SERVICE OF ANIMALS.
We've been coming to this veterinary clinic for over two and a half years, ever since we welcomed our dwarf lop-eared rabbit into our family. Having never had …
I have known the Clinic Director, Dr. Fabio Bartoli, for many years. I admire and respect him for his great humanity, his helpfulness, and, of course, his professionalism and efficiency. …
Discovered for an emergency. Prompt intervention and excellent results. Thank you!
